name: Off Bowling
short: Arcade bowling: 8 locations, bosses, medals and a bowler shop. Spin it, strike!
full:
Off Bowling is a colourful arcade bowling game made for quick one-hand play.

Drag the ball to place it, lock your aim, hit the power at the right moment and hold the screen edges to spin the ball into the pocket. A zoom camera follows your ball right into the pins.

MODES
- Career: 8 locations, each with 8 events and a boss match. Rules change every event: versus, score targets, strikes, heavy pins, dodging obstacles, combos, collecting rings, converting spares and no-gutter challenges. Win bronze, silver and gold medals.
- Quick Match: pick a bowler, game type, opponent, location and an optional bet.
- Tournament: a 16-bowler knockout for the trophy.
- Shop: 12 balls and 16 bowlers with rising stats. Find lottery tickets on the lane for rare prizes.
- Missions that track your progress in every mode.

FEATURES
- Painted locations, glossy neon lanes and satisfying pin physics
- Easy touch controls, portrait play
- Watch an optional ad after a game to double your coins
- Works offline

Free to play with ads. Made by Arcadoff.
